title: NVIDIA CEO Proposes Kazakhstan as Global Hub for Physical AI
script:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang proposed turning Kazakhstan into a global hub for physical AI.
He met President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev in Astana to discuss this strategic expansion.
Physical AI integrates digital software with robotics to automate complex industrial tasks.
Huang highlighted Kazakhstan's potential to become a regional leader in AI infrastructure.
Tokayev confirmed the country is now accelerating its national AI development strategy.
The government is currently prioritizing advanced digital training for its local workforce.
Could this collaboration transform Kazakhstan into a key node in the global AI supply chain?
